content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script for the FUNWAVE-TVD simple case beach_2d_radiation. Builds a 250x50 grid with dx=dy=2.0 (L3-L9), loads instantaneous output snapshot number 21 (num=21 L12, filename suffix via sprintf('%.5d',num) L13): surface elevation eta_ (L15), breaking source BrkSrcX_ (L16), friction FrcInsX_ (L17), and draws figure(1) with three pcolor subplots (inst eta L23-L30, inst brk stress in x L32-L39, inst fric stress in x L41-L48) each limited to axis([300 500 0 90]), printed to break_frc_inst.jpg (L50). Then loads averaged output number 4 (num=4 L53): FRCX_ (L57) and BrkDissX_ (L58), and draws figure(2) with three analogous subplots (inst eta L66-L73, avg brk stress L75-L82, avg fric stress L84-L91), printed to break_frc_avg.jpg (L94). Colorbar labels identify the breaking term as (h+\eta)R_{bx} (m^2/s^2) (L38, L81) and the friction term as -C_d uU (m^2/s^2) (L47, L90).
